# PlanBridge

> Inline comments on coding-agent plans and markdown docs.

PlanBridge is an open-source CLI that opens coding-agent plans, specs, RFCs, and other markdown documents in a local browser review UI. Reviewers can highlight text, leave inline comments, approve, or request changes before the agent continues.

PlanBridge includes Claude Code and Codex CLI integrations, but the core commands are harness-agnostic. Any agent that can run shell commands can pipe markdown to `contextbridge plan`, run `contextbridge open <file>`, and read the markdown response on stdout.

- Claude Code usage: https://plan.contextbridge.ai/usage/claude-code/
- Codex CLI usage: https://plan.contextbridge.ai/usage/codex/
- Other agents: https://plan.contextbridge.ai/usage/other-agents/
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/contextbridge/planbridge

## Summary

PlanBridge helps developers steer AI coding agents before code is written. `contextbridge plan` reviews proposed plans through a local browser UI and returns approved or requested-change feedback to the agent. `contextbridge open` uses the same annotation loop for any markdown document, including specs, design docs, RFCs, and plans saved outside a native plan-mode hook.
